stem.en: Kabir reads that some cars run on "hydrogen fuel" and their exhaust is only water. He says "so hydrogen is free energy, water is everywhere". What is missing?

text.en: The hydrogen had to be made by pushing water back up the Hill, with electricity, at a cost bigger than the car gets back. Hydrogen is a way to carry energy, not a source of it.

feedback.en: Water is at the bottom of the Hill. Getting hydrogen out of it is electrolysis, and Book I showed the battery doing the work.
They are real. They are a battery with the charging done at the factory and the discharge done in the car.

text.en: Hydrogen burns to something other than water.

feedback.en: It burns to water, which is exactly why it is clean at the tailpipe and exactly why the hydrogen had to be lifted out of water first.

explanation.en: Ask where the fuel's fall came from. Every fuel was pushed up the Hill by something. For hydrogen from water, that something is a power station.
